definition: אֲתָרִים proper name, of a location only Num 21:1 ׳ דֶּרֶח הָא ; so ᵐ5 , perhaps ( Di ) name of a caravan-route, compare vestige, footprint ; others (after ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ) translate way of the spies (compare Num 13:22 ); but הָאֲתָרִים for הַתָּרִים is highly improbable, and a locality would hardly receive its designation from the spies.
